events.title: The election of Pope Francis
events.shortBlurb: The cardinals chose Jorge Mario Bergoglio of Buenos Aires, the first pope from the Americas and the first Jesuit…
body: On the evening of 13 March 2013, following the resignation of Pope Benedict XVI, the conclave elected Cardinal Jorge Mario Bergoglio, archbishop of Buenos Aires, as the 266th pope. He took the name Francis, after St. Francis of Assisi — the first pope ever to bear it.

He was the first pope from the Americas, the first from the Southern Hemisphere, and the first member of the Society of Jesus to be elected. From the balcony of St. Peter's he first asked the crowd to pray for him before he gave his blessing, striking a note of simplicity and mercy that would mark his call to serve the poor and those on the peripheries.
